summary: Wellchange Holdings Co Ltd files Form 6-K reporting the board's removal of independent directors Wang Yiyun and Liu Jun effective June 9, 2026, with immediate appointments of Lau Yun Chau and Lau Chun, who assume the vacated committee chairs and memberships. The board remains six members with a majority independent. The filing documents a forced/abrupt board shake-up triggered by the registrant itself, without any disclosed financial terms, premium, or deal structure. This qualifies as a Management Change special situation. Watch for potential governance disputes, shareholder reaction, or subsequent SEC inquiries regarding the removals.
